long_description: Total Brain is a comprehensive brain health and mental wellness platform that measures 12 core brain capacities across emotion, feeling, cognition, and self-control domains. The platform is built on 50+ years of neuroscience research and has been validated in peer-reviewed studies. Total Brain offers a scientifically validated brain assessment taking approximately 20 minutes, followed by personalized brain training exercises, meditation programs, and sleep improvement content. For employers and health plans, Total Brain provides population-level mental health risk analytics, identifying employees at risk for depression, anxiety, and stress before they become clinical. The platform integrates with EAP and healthcare benefits to triage users to appropriate levels of care. Total Brain is publicly traded on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX: TTB) and serves enterprise customers globally.

faqs.a: Total Brain measures 12 core brain capacities across four domains: Emotion (identification, bias, resilience), Feeling (anxiety, depression, stress), Cognition (attention, memory, flexibility, executive function), and Self-control (impulsivity, risk-taking).

faqs.q: How long does the Total Brain assessment take?
faqs.a: The Total Brain assessment takes approximately 20 minutes to complete and provides personalized insights based on 50+ years of neuroscience research.

faqs.q: Is Total Brain for individuals or employers?
faqs.a: Total Brain primarily serves employers and health plans as an enterprise solution for workforce mental health screening and brain wellness. It is not typically sold to individual practitioners.
Yes, Total Brain is built on 50+ years of neuroscience research and has been validated in peer-reviewed scientific publications using standardized neuropsychological test paradigms.
